$comment: LANE-O (D-LK-IMAGE-DATA-SLOT-EXTERN-ADDR, PE fail-loud witness; roadmap C2): `unsigned char **p = &_mbcasemap;` -- the address of a REAL ucrtbase.dll DATA export in a file-scope initializer -- is REJECTED on the pe64 image arm. PE has no symbol-based image relocation, so baking the extern's IAT-slot VA into the pointer slot would leave `p` one indirection off (MSVC rejects the same shape, C2099); pe::encodeExec FAILS LOUD with K_RelocationKindMismatch naming _mbcasemap + this anchor and emits NO binary. Drives the full pipeline through the in-process runner AND the CLI subprocess, asserting a rejected compile with no artifact. The reject is a linker-tier diagnostic with NO source span, so it renders code-only (`error[K_RelocationKindMismatch]`) -> positioned:false (the in-process runner matches the CODE; the CLI harness greps `error[K_RelocationKindMismatch]`). The message-text pins (anchor + the extern name + C2099) live in the structural test PeExecWriterExternSlot.DataItemRelocTargetingExternDataFailsLoudOnExecToo. ** WHY THE SUBJECT CHANGED FROM `_fmode`, AND WHY THAT MATTERED MORE THAN A RENAME: this example was FAILING FOR THE WRONG REASON, with its real subject MASKED. `_fmode` is not a ucrtbase export at all -- MEASURED 2026-08-10 on two concurring instruments (GNU objdump 2.42 `-p`, MSVC dumpbin 14.44.35207 `-exports`) over all 2,484 exports of the live ucrtbase.dll 10.0.26100.8875, `_fmode` and `_environ` are BOTH ABSENT; UCRT publishes them only via `__p__fmode` (ordinal 88) / `__p__environ` (ordinal 87). With `externLibraryByFormat` removed from c-subset.lang.json and the descriptor corpus now the SINGLE owner of realization, a bare `extern int _fmode;` was UNBOUND, so the build died at K_SymbolUndefined (src/link/linker.cpp:174) and never reached the data-item relocation this manifest exists to pin. The fix is a real DATA export: `_mbcasemap` (ucrtbase ordinal 527, RVA 0x001397E0, inside READ-WRITE `.data`; also msvcrt ordinal 520), shipped from ctype.json as a pe-gated `kind: object` row -- the first `kind: object` row the pe axis has ever had. It is typed `ptr<u8>` rather than an array because MEASURED the UCRT export holds a POINTER to the case map and not the map itself; see extern_data_import_pe for that probe, its matched msvcrt control, and [[D-FFI-UCRT-HEADER-DECLARES-MBCASEMAP-AS-ARRAY]]. The object's own type is incidental to THIS manifest, whose subject is `&<extern DATA object>` in a static initializer. RED-ON-DISABLE: drop the pe.cpp extern-DATA data-item reject -> silent one-indirection-off bake -> zero diagnostics -> this manifest fails; un-ship ctype.json's `_mbcasemap` row -> the failure regresses to K_SymbolUndefined, which is the wrong-reason state this example was rescued from and which a manifest asserting merely `some error` would have concealed -- the exact CODE pin is the load-bearing part. The ELF/Mach-O positive counterpart (they HAVE a symbol-based fold) is extern_data_addr_static_init; the FUNCTION-extern-address positive on PE is addr_import (its symbolVa is a callable import thunk, kept legal by c152).
